in_scope.instructions:
Cloudways API offers an alternative to the Cloudways Platform. Many, but not all actions that Cloudways Platform allows through the UI can also be performed through Cloudways API.

In the event a vulnerability is applicable to both the Cloudways Platform (platform.cloudways.com) and API, it will be treated as one root incident.

in_scope.instructions: Cloudways Platform is the primary target for this program. Cloudways Platform is the main interaction point for Cloudways customers. Through the Platform, customers could launch managed cloud servers and then set up their application on these servers. Once the application is up, Cloudways Platform provides users with options to manage their servers and applications.
